name: Is a bathroom refresh enough, or do I need a full remodel after foreclosure?
description: Choose a refresh if the room works and only looks worn. Choose a full remodel if there is major damage, bad layout, or repeated plumbing issues.

mainEntity.name: Is a bathroom refresh enough, or do I need a full remodel after foreclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: A foreclosed bathroom refresh is often chosen when the room is functional but dated, while a full remodel is better when the layout is bad or the systems are failing. If the vanity, tub, toilet, and tile are mostly serviceable, a refresh usually gives the best value; if the room has repeated leaks or major damage, remodeling is the safer choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a refresh if the room works and only looks worn. Choose a full remodel if there is major damage, bad layout, or repeated plumbing issues.
